name: Mango Saffron Yogurt
ingredients: ½ small ripe mango (about 80 g), pureed
A pinch of saffron soaked in 1 tbsp warm water
steps: Soak the saffron in warm water for 10 minutes.
Whisk the yogurt with the mango puree, saffron and its water, and cardamom until smooth.
Divide between two bowls and top with mint.
note: Mango is high in natural sugar, so keep the portion small; the yogurt balances it with protein.
